disposition_reason: Original ICP-MS and AMA measurements of 19 elements in Brassica pekinensis leaves from 19 sampling points at two Kinshasa urban gardening sites.

study.design: Field sampling of Brassica pekinensis leaves at two urban gardening sites with dietary risk assessment
study.origin: urban gardening sites Cecomaf (Ndjili) and Lutendele (Mont Ngafula), Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo
study.method: ICP-MS after HNO3/H2O2 digestion of lyophilized leaves (105 °C, 16 h); total Hg by AMA-254 direct mercury analyzer
lod: LOD (mg/kg) Ti 0.098, V 0.024, Cr 0.000, Mn 0.150, Fe 0.681, Co 0.025, Ni 0.000, Cu 1.516, Zn 2.033, As 0.049, Cd 0.063, Pb 1.091, Hg 0.005 (Table 1); Hg detection limit 0.005 mg/kg (Section 2.3)
study.qa: CRM BCR-482 (lichen): recoveries above 93%; Hg 0.46 vs 0.48 mg/kg certified (~96%); triplicate CV < 2%, blanks < 1% of signal
